name: Duke
subtitle: Zone offense: seal the elbow, overload one side
goal: Seal the elbow defender inside and overload the ball side. Read it, don't force it.
options: 1 reads: pull-up, 2 in the corner, 4 at the elbow, or 5 on the block. 4 can go high-low to 5. Nothing? Reverse to 3.

steps.note: 4 comes up and screens the defender at the elbow from the outside, so that defender cannot get out toward the three-point line. Hold the screen still.
1 dribbles to the wing. That pushes 2 to the corner and pulls 3 to the top. 5 cuts to the block on the ball side for the overload. 4 keeps the seal at the elbow.
Now it is 4-on-3. 1 does not drive all the way in. 1 reads it: pull-up, 2 in the corner, 4 at the elbow, or 5 on the block. 4 can also go high-low to 5.
Nothing there? Reverse the ball to 3 and run it again on the other side.
